Excellent welcome, clear and frank diagnosis, no beating around the bush. Competent and responsive medical team. I know they will do everything to treat Athos.

A huge disappointment after nearly 10 years of loyalty

Lilas was a patient of Dr. Benalloul for almost ten years. Until last year, and despite sometimes excessive fees, I was quite satisfied with his care and the treatment of my dog. It is precisely for this reason that last year's experience was all the more difficult to accept.

Since the clinic was taken over by the Sevetys group, I have unfortunately noticed a decline in the quality of the customer experience and the care provided, which ultimately led me to change veterinarians.

Last year, during a dental cleaning performed by a colleague at the practice, Lilas developed an extremely serious bacterial infection. Her condition deteriorated rapidly, and she had to be hospitalized at Frégis, where she arrived in critical condition. This hospitalization was a terrible ordeal, both for her and for me.

I deeply regret that the necessary measures were not taken to prevent or detect this complication earlier. I also question why Lilas wasn't referred more quickly to Frégis, a facility specializing in veterinary emergencies. This might have prevented her condition from worsening, limited her suffering, and saved us nearly €1,000 in additional expenses.

I also deplore the fact that, in my experience, animals are systematically referred to the Sevetys Hospital in the 12th arrondissement, rather than to Frégis, when their condition requires specialized care. I believe it is essential to prioritize the animal's medical needs and direct them to the facility best suited to their condition.

Another particularly shocking experience was the reception at the clinic. Upon leaving the hospital, Lilas suffered from severe diarrhea. I went to the clinic to ask for advice and to consult Dr. Benalloul. I simply wanted to know if a veterinarian could take a look at Lilas and tell me if it was necessary to return to the emergency clinic at Frégis Hospital.

The young man at reception responded in a very dismissive manner, criticizing me for coming without an appointment and explaining that "this isn't an emergency facility." This lack of empathy, especially since my dog ​​had just been hospitalized for a serious condition, deeply shocked me.

Today, I decided to change clinics.

I went to V Clinic, located at 72 rue Saint-Charles, in the 15th arrondissement of Paris, which opened in August 2026. This clinic is run by a team of four young, independent veterinarians.

My experience there has been far more positive: a more welcoming atmosphere, more modern facilities, and prices that I find significantly more reasonable.

After nearly ten years of loyalty to Dr. Benalloul, I sincerely regret having to switch to another doctor.
Dr. Berros is very kind and competent, thank you for taking care of Brioche 🧡 …
This clinic is really great and Dr. Benalloul is fantastic, reassuring for the animals and a great teacher with humans!

We took Alf to this veterinary clinic at the beginning of the year for his first booster vaccinations, and then again a little before summer for his neutering. We also went back recently, before the start of the school year, for a check-up, mainly because he had some itching and we wanted to make sure everything was alright.
Over the course of these appointments, we saw three different veterinarians, and we were very satisfied each time. They all showed great kindness and gentleness with Alf, even when he was really uncomfortable at the vet's.
The premises are very clean, and the reception from the veterinary assistants is always very friendly and welcoming. We particularly appreciate the time they give us: when we have questions or need explanations, everything is explained to us in great detail and clearly. And even when we have questions after the appointment, the team doesn't hesitate to take the time to answer us thoroughly by email. It's truly wonderful to feel listened to, supported, and to know that Alf is in good hands. We are currently very satisfied with this practice and highly recommend it! 🐾

Very disappointing experience. They refused to provide tapeworm treatment for travel simply because they had never seen my dog before. I find this a very strange reason, especially when I only needed the required treatment and documentation for travelling. I had to find another vet instead. Would not recommend for this.
A very professional team, incredibly attentive to the animals and always friendly and welcoming. It's so reassuring for us and our kitties! Thank you to them!

I would like to extend my sincere gratitude to Agathe and Valentin. Thanks to your help, which was treated as if it were your own business, I was able to safely enter the UK with my dog. Our itinerary was somewhat unique, involving a stopover in Korea and France before entering the UK on a Monday. Despite the extremely tight schedule, you both actively assisted us, allowing us to safely receive our French quarantine documents on the Friday immediately preceding our departure. When I visit France next year, I would love to visit you in person to express my sincere thanks. Once again, I am truly grateful for your warm kindness and thoughtful consideration. May you always be at peace and stay healthy!
The entire team is excellent: competent, attentive, and friendly. I trust them completely. Our Cavalier King Charles Spaniel is happy to go to the vet!

Many professionals, including Dr. Benichou.
Everyone is pleasant and efficient.

Frémicourt Veterinary Clinic Paris - Sevetys

Dr. Agathe is competent and quickly provided excellent guidance for our 2-year-old chow chow, whom we adopted in September 2025. However, other consultations with other veterinarians were more hit-or-miss: they didn't read the file properly and tended to downplay the symptoms. The worst experience was yesterday, during a consultation with the clinic manager: we had to insist that he examine our dog, including his heart, stomach, paws, and blood work. The blood work highlighted the problems, but this gentleman preferred to...
The whole team is wonderful, with empathy and kindness, competence, availability and gentleness towards both the animals and their owners.

As usual, I received excellent service.
It's never fun for my cat to get his booster shots, but the vet knew how to reassure him during the examination: so much more comfortable!
Thank you for your professionalism and kindness.
June 12, 2025: Another visit and still received excellent service.
A little stressed, as usual, my cat was very well taken care of by Dr. BEROS, who was very reassuring during the consultation.
A big thank you again to the whole team.
June 15, 2026: I stand by my comments => still very happy with my visit.
